problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate the annual budget across 18 different infrastructure projects to maximize overall community benefit.  
The profile for each project is given below:  
* Project A: benefit score 0.149, impact rating 0.159, allocation limits [0.093, 0.609]  
* Project B: benefit score 0.146, impact rating 0.286, allocation limits [0.064, 0.392]  
* Project C: benefit score 0.155, impact rating 0.133, allocation limits [0.083, 0.374]  
* Project D: benefit score 0.064, impact rating 0.120, allocation limits [0.004, 0.592]  
* Project E: benefit score 0.153, impact rating 0.118, allocation limits [0.046, 0.393]  
* Project F: benefit score 0.191, impact rating 0.043, allocation limits [0.062, 0.694]  
* Project G: benefit score 0.168, impact rating 0.275, allocation limits [0.049, 0.436]  
* Project H: benefit score 0.178, impact rating 0.082, allocation limits [0.036, 0.537]  
* Project I: benefit score 0.115, impact rating 0.166, allocation limits [0.062, 0.480]  
* Project J: benefit score 0.130, impact rating 0.232, allocation limits [0.033, 0.557]  
* Project K: benefit score 0.129, impact rating 0.044, allocation limits [0.035, 0.409]  
* Project L: benefit score 0.194, impact rating 0.097, allocation limits [0.001, 0.787]  
* Project M: benefit score 0.141, impact rating 0.095, allocation limits [0.089, 0.365]  
* Project N: benefit score 0.179, impact rating 0.072, allocation limits [0.019, 0.563]  
* Project O: benefit score 0.114, impact rating 0.224, allocation limits [0.035, 0.804]  
* Project P: benefit score 0.061, impact rating 0.175, allocation limits [0.010, 0.397]  
* Project Q: benefit score 0.034, impact rating 0.073, allocation limits [0.049, 0.512]  
* Project R: benefit score 0.171, impact rating 0.098, allocation limits [0.008, 0.560]  

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified limits, and the sum of all budget shares must equal the total budget of 1.  
To prioritize key public services, the planner requires that projects in the high-priority set L = {A, B, C, E, F, G, I, K, L, M, O, Q, R} together receive at least 0.677 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the total impact rating of the portfolio must not exceed 0.170, and the overall benefit score must be at least 0.117.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
